mapper.insert: insert into test_info (info_id, info_name, info_desc, logo_id, topo_id, scheme_id, create_time, update_time, user_id) values (#{infoId}, #{infoName}, #{infoDesc}, #{logoId}, #{topoId}, #{schemeId}, now(), now(), #{userId})
mapper.select: select count(*) from test_info where user_id = #{userId}
